# launchdarkly_environment_release_plan (Data Source)

Provides a LaunchDarkly environment release plan data source.

~> **Beta:** This data source wraps a beta LaunchDarkly API (the `release-plans` endpoints, accessed with the `LD-API-Version: beta` header). Beta resources may change or be removed in future versions.

This data source allows you to retrieve release plan information from a LaunchDarkly environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "launchdarkly_environment_release_plan" "checkout_rollout" {
  project_key     = "example-project"
  environment_key = "production"
  key             = "checkout-rollout"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_key` (String) The key of the environment the release plan belongs to.
- `key` (String) The unique human-readable key that references the release plan.
- `project_key` (String) The release plan's project key.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The description of the release plan's purpose.
- `id` (String) The ID in the format `project_key/environment_key/key`.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this plan is the environment's default release plan.
- `name` (String) The human-friendly name for the release plan.
- `progressive_release` (Attributes) Configuration for the progressive release this plan runs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--progressive_release))
- `release_method` (String) The release method the plan uses. Currently always `progressive_release`.
- `version` (Number) The release plan's version. Starts at 1 and increments on every update.

<a id="nestedatt--progressive_release"></a>
### Nested Schema for `progressive_release`

Read-Only:

- `advancement_mode` (String) Whether a release started from this plan advances to the next phase automatically (`automatic`) or waits for a user or API action (`manual`).
- `cleanup_behavior` (String) What happens to the flag's targeting rules once a release started from this plan completes. One of `remove_rules_and_update_default_rule` or `leave_rules_in_place`.
- `metrics` (Attributes Map) Metrics and metric groups monitored during the rollout, keyed by metric or metric group key. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--progressive_release--metrics))
- `phases` (Attributes List) An ordered list of phases the release progresses through. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--progressive_release--phases))
- `randomization_unit` (String) The context kind key used to bucket contexts for allocation.

<a id="nestedatt--progressive_release--metrics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `progressive_release.metrics`

Read-Only:

- `auto_rollback` (Boolean) Whether the release automatically rolls back if this metric or metric group regresses.
- `is_group` (Boolean) Whether the key identifies a metric group (`true`) or a single metric (`false`).


<a id="nestedatt--progressive_release--phases"></a>
### Nested Schema for `progressive_release.phases`

Read-Only:

- `clauses` (Attributes List) Clauses applied as the rule's logical condition. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--progressive_release--phases--clauses))
- `description` (String) The description of this phase.
- `steps` (Attributes List) Ordered allocation increments within this phase. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--progressive_release--phases--steps))

<a id="nestedatt--progressive_release--phases--clauses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `progressive_release.phases.clauses`

Read-Only:

- `attribute` (String) User attribute to operate on.
- `context_kind` (String) Context kind for the clause.
- `negate` (Boolean) Whether to negate the clause.
- `op` (String) The operator associated with the rule clause. Available options are `in`, `endsWith`, `startsWith`, `matches`, `contains`, `lessThan`, `greaterThan`, `lessThanOrEqual`, `greaterThanOrEqual`, `before`, `after`, `segmentMatch`, `semVerEqual`, `semVerLessThan`, and `semVerGreaterThan`. To learn more, read [Operators](https://launchdarkly.com/docs/sdk/concepts/flag-evaluation-rules#operators).
- `value_type` (String) Type of each clause value (boolean / string / number).
- `values` (List of String) Values for the clause.


<a id="nestedatt--progressive_release--phases--steps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `progressive_release.phases.steps`

Read-Only:

- `allocation` (Number) The traffic allocation for this step, in per-100,000 units. `100000` is 100% of traffic.
- `duration_millis` (Number) How long this step holds, in milliseconds, before the next step starts.
